title: Everlastings by Emaline
subtitle: An artisan e-commerce store run by a custom GPT, for $30 a year.
seo_title: Everlastings by Emaline | AI-Run Artisan E-Commerce
seo_description: A custom e-commerce store, CMS, and ops panel for a one-person artisan shop — authored by a custom GPT on $30/year of infrastructure.
challenge: A small artisan shop needed a real storefront — product pages, checkout, inventory, order fulfillment, marketing — without enterprise e-commerce pricing or a technical operator. Shopify-class subscriptions would consume the margin on one-of-a-kind pieces, and the client writes poetic story cards by voice, not spreadsheets. The business needed to run on language, not dashboards.
approach: A custom GPT became the authoring interface: the client describes a new piece conversationally, drops in photos, and reviews a structured preview before anything goes live. Behind it, a thin stack — Supabase for the catalog, Stripe for payments, Cloudinary for transforms, Cloudflare R2 for the CDN, Vercel for hosting — runs for roughly $30 a year. Every mutation follows an AI-proposes → human-approves → execution pattern, so the GPT drafts copy, shapes records, and lines up images, but the client is always the one who says ship.
result: The client can now launch a product by talking to ChatGPT: photos flow through Cloudinary to the R2 CDN, a Supabase insert triggers an automatic Stripe product and price, and a permalink lands back in the chat within seconds. The admin panel handles orders and shipping when she wants a form; the GPT handles everything else when she wants a conversation. A one-person workshop gets the authoring layer of a much larger brand — at roughly the price of a domain.

metric.context: Full stack — database, payments, CDN, hosting, and AI authoring layer — for a live artisan storefront.
